title: Pray for Us, Warning Against Idleness

questions.question: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may speed ahead and be ____, as happened among you.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:1 (ESV): "Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may speed ahead and be honored, as happened among you,"

questions.question: And that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men. For not all have ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:2 (ESV): "and that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men. For not all have faith."

questions.question: But the Lord is faithful. He will establish you and ____ you against the evil one.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:3 (ESV): "But the Lord is faithful. He will establish you and guard you against the evil one."

questions.question: And we have confidence in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things that we ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:4 (ESV): "And we have confidence in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things that we command."

questions.question: May the Lord direct your hearts to the love of God and to the ____ of Christ.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:5 (ESV): "May the Lord direct your hearts to the love of God and to the steadfastness of Christ."

questions.question: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from any brother who is walking in ____ and not in accord with the tradition that you received from us.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:6 (ESV): "Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from any brother who is walking in idleness and not in accord with the tradition that you received from us."

questions.question: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not idle when we were with you, nor did we eat anyone's bread without ____
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:7-8 (ESV): "For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not idle when we were with you, nor did we eat anyone's bread without paying for it..."

questions.question: But with toil and labor we worked night and day, that we might not be a ____ to any of you.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:8 (ESV): "but with toil and labor we worked night and day, that we might not be a burden to any of you."

questions.question: It was not because we do not have that ____, but to give you in ourselves an example to imitate.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:9 (ESV): "It was not because we do not have that right, but to give you in ourselves an example to imitate."

questions.question: For even when we were with you, we would give you this command: If anyone is not willing to work, let him not ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:10 (ESV): "For even when we were with you, we would give you this command: If anyone is not willing to work, let him not eat."

questions.question: For we hear that some among you walk in idleness, not busy at work, but ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:11 (ESV): "For we hear that some among you walk in idleness, not busy at work, but busybodies."

questions.question: Now such persons we command and encourage in the Lord Jesus Christ to do their work quietly and to earn their own ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:12 (ESV): "Now such persons we command and encourage in the Lord Jesus Christ to do their work quietly and to earn their own living."

questions.question: As for you, brothers, do not grow weary in doing ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:13 (ESV): "As for you, brothers, do not grow weary in doing good."

questions.question: If anyone does not obey what we say in this letter, take note of that person, and have ____ with him, that he may be ashamed.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:14 (ESV): "If anyone does not obey what we say in this letter, take note of that person, and have nothing to do with him, that he may be ashamed."

questions.question: Do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:15 (ESV): "Do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother."

key_verse_text: But the Lord is faithful. He will establish you and guard you against the evil one.
